analysis_method: Claude visual inspection of the full image

structural_characteristics.layout: Ten numbered modular cards on a two-column grid that snakes: row 1 full width, row 2 right-to-left, then rows alternate; final row ends in a highlighted terminal card.
structural_characteristics.reading_direction: Serpentine; order carried by large numbered badges plus dashed arrow connectors between modules.
patterns: logo tile grids (icon tile + label below)
labelled chip/checklist rows inside a sub-panel
stepped awareness staircase with numbered pills
small branching start node inside module 01
dashed connectors with arrowheads in margins
structural_characteristics.hierarchy: Title band > numbered module > sub-panel/column > item row or tile.
structural_characteristics.containment: Strong: every item sits in a module; sub-panels nest inside modules.

design_characteristics.background: Light warm off-white with subtle dot texture; layered tab shapes behind the title.
design_characteristics.color_treatment: Mostly neutral; one saturated accent on title band and some badges; a mint/green accent on number badges and the terminal card; brand logos in original colors.
design_characteristics.typography: Very heavy condensed display title; bold all-caps module titles; small sans-serif labels (exact fonts not determinable).
design_characteristics.containers: Rounded rectangles with thin dark outline and offset solid shadow; tabbed header on each module.
design_characteristics.connectors: Thin dashed gray lines with small arrowheads routed in gutters; no connector labels.
design_characteristics.numbering: Two-digit numerals in high-contrast badges at each module tab.
design_characteristics.icons: Rounded-square logo tiles; small monochrome line icons in list rows.
design_characteristics.decoration: Minimal; footer band with creator identity (not to be reused).

content_capacity.observed: ~10 modules, ~100 visible labelled items including ~45 logo tiles; legible at native resolution.
content_capacity.notes: Capacity comparable to this run (102 nodes); qualitative, not a hard limit.

limitations: No pattern for a hub with converging inputs; would need adaptation.
Final modules are numbered; unnumbered downstream items need adaptation.
Includes a closed-lost branch pattern that must not be reused here.
uncertainties: Exact fonts, colors and spacing values not measured.
Whether the dot texture is part of the design system or export artifact.

evidence.observation: Large two-line title with category breadcrumb and icon box.
Start node branching to two outcome mini-cards, a tool list, and labelled checklist chip rows.
Logo tile grids and a stacked tier list, read right-to-left with dashed arrows.
Five numbered pills in a descending staircase above a gradient bar.
Four column cards each with a header and icon+label rows.
Filled accent terminal card with three logo tiles.

content_isolation: Reference text, names, logos, claims and creator branding are not carried into this run; only layout/design patterns are profiled.
